issuer: the Virgin Islands Bureau of Motor Vehicles (BMV)
note: Read 2026-10-30 on bmv.vi.gov. The driver's license page says a first-time applicant must be at least 16 (a parent or guardian signs the learner's permit under 18; no provisional stage is named, so the licence is held from 16); the fees page gives a REAL ID driver's license or identification card (adult) at $55.00 and a Virgin Islands identification card (adult) at $35.00. No term for either was read, so both are null. The learner's permit, the written and road tests ($20.00 each) and the senior and under-16 fees aren't held. The territory issues no other identity card (the ids engine reads the United States' papers for it).

sources.title: USVI Bureau of Motor Vehicles, ID | Drivers License
sources.said: To obtain a driver's license for the first time in the Virgin Islands, applicants must be at least 16 years old.
